sources.title: ONAT – Ministerio de Finanzas y Precios

conditions.label: Has employees
conditions.description: Pays wages or salaries and runs a payroll.

conditions.label: Registered for VAT
conditions.description: Registered for value added tax or a similar turnover tax.

conditions.label: Listed on a stock exchange
conditions.description: Its shares trade on a regulated market.

profileFields.label: Company name
profileFields.description: The registered name, including the S.A. legal form. A company that can issue shares.

profileFields.label: Número de registro mercantil
profileFields.description: The number the company register gave the company.

profileFields.label: Registered office address
profileFields.description: The address on the company register.

profileFields.label: Capital social
profileFields.description: The capital the company was registered with. Leave it empty if the form has no share capital.

roles.label: Director
roles.description: Sits on the board and runs the company.

roles.label: Officer
roles.description: A senior officer named by the board.

setupSteps.title: Choose and check the S.A. name
setupSteps.description: Check the name is free in Registro Mercantil and follows Cuba's naming rules.

setupSteps.title: Prepare the S.A. documents
setupSteps.description: Prepare the articles or statutes, the founders' details and the registered office. The registration process sets out what it needs.

setupSteps.title: Register the S.A.
setupSteps.description: Submit the incorporation documents as Registro Mercantil requires. The company exists once the register enters it.

setupSteps.title: Register the S.A. for tax
setupSteps.description: Register with ONAT – Oficina Nacional de Administración Tributaria for the company's tax number and any VAT or payroll accounts it needs.
setupSteps.authority: ONAT – Oficina Nacional de Administración Tributaria

setupSteps.title: Register as an employer
setupSteps.description: Before the first hire, register with Ministerio de Trabajo y Seguridad Social for payroll and social contributions.
setupSteps.authority: Ministerio de Trabajo y Seguridad Social

setupSteps.title: Open a business bank account
setupSteps.description: Banks usually ask for the registration certificate and the tax number.

setupSteps.title: Check licences for your activity
setupSteps.description: Some activities need a permit or a licence from a sector regulator. Check before you start trading.

obligations.title: Annual return or confirmation statement
obligations.description: Check whether an annual return or confirmation statement is due with Registro Mercantil, then file it and keep the company record current.

obligations.title: Annual financial statements
obligations.description: Prepare the annual accounts. Check whether they must be filed with Registro Mercantil, the deadline and whether an audit is required.

obligations.title: Corporate income tax return
obligations.description: Check the company's income tax filing with ONAT – Oficina Nacional de Administración Tributaria, then file the return and pay by the dates it sets.
obligations.authority: ONAT – Oficina Nacional de Administración Tributaria

obligations.title: VAT returns
obligations.description: File VAT returns with ONAT – Oficina Nacional de Administración Tributaria and pay any VAT due. Check whether the company is registered and how often it files.
obligations.authority: ONAT – Oficina Nacional de Administración Tributaria

obligations.title: Payroll taxes and social contributions
obligations.description: Withhold and remit payroll taxes and social contributions for employees through Ministerio de Trabajo y Seguridad Social. Check the rates and dates.
obligations.authority: Ministerio de Trabajo y Seguridad Social

obligations.title: Beneficial ownership information
obligations.description: Check whether the country requires a beneficial ownership filing. If it does, keep the record up to date and file it with Registro Mercantil.

obligations.title: Report changes to the register
obligations.description: Check what changes must be reported to Registro Mercantil, then tell it about changes to the name, address, directors or share capital within its deadline.

obligations.title: Renew licences and permits
obligations.description: Check which licences your activity needs and renew them before they expire.

obligations.title: Annual general meeting
obligations.description: Hold the annual general meeting and record the resolutions.

obligations.title: Audit the annual accounts
obligations.description: Have the annual accounts audited if the company meets the audit threshold.

obligations.title: Disclose market information
obligations.description: Publish information that could affect the share price as the market rules require.
